result.title: RFBench: A Simulator-Grounded Multimodal Benchmark for Passive RF Layout Design and Understanding
result.summary: While multimodal language models can interpret diagrams and generate structured outputs, their capacity to connect passive radio-frequency (RF) design intent, layout geometry, and electromagnetic behavior remains largely untested. To address this gap, we introduce RFBench, a simulator-grounded dataset and benchmark for passive RF layout design and understanding. The dataset contains 10,000 two-port planar layouts simulated using ADS Momentum, with each layout represented by editable geometric primitives, a raster image, a 16x16 occupancy grid, complex S-parameters at 201 frequency points, a structural category, and an RF response label. Building on these aligned representations, we define seven tasks spanning specification-conditioned layout generation, representation translation, response prediction, simulator-based validation, design diagnosis and improvement, structural understanding, and response classification. Extensive baselines across seven multimodal language models reveal systematic weaknesses in generating structurally valid layouts and predicting electromagnetically faithful responses. We show that RF-specific fine-tuning increases T1a structural validity from 0.0% to 83.2% and the T3 primitive-input within-2-dB rate from 17.7% to 62.8%, demonstrating the value of domain adaptation while leaving considerable room for further progress. RFBench establishes a common testbed for evaluating multimodal RF capabilities and guiding the development of models that connect design intent and layout representations with physical behavior.

AI.brief_summary: RFBench 构建了基于 ADS Momentum 仿真的被动射频版图多模态数据集与基准，每条布局配有几何基元、栅格图像、占据栅格和 201 点 S 参数，并定义版图生成、表示翻译、响应预测、仿真验证等七类任务，评测多个多模态语言模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「表示翻译」与仿真器校验任务可为核查几何/空间细节是否保留在模型状态、以及以外部仿真结果作为证据校验提供借鉴，但当前指标停留在输出层面，是否可用于 latent 状态分析尚待核查。
